name: React + Next.js
description: Enforces modern React patterns with Next.js App Router and Server Components.
content:
# React + Next.js Rules

- Use Server Components by default — only add `'use client'` when you need interactivity or browser APIs
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions — `page.tsx`, `layout.tsx`, `loading.tsx`, `error.tsx`
- No class components — functional components with hooks only
- Follow the Rules of Hooks — never call hooks conditionally or in loops
- Co-locate related files — component, styles, tests, and types in the same directory
- Use `next/image` for images, `next/link` for navigation, `next/font` for fonts
- Fetch data in Server Components using `async` functions — avoid `useEffect` for data fetching
- Use React Server Actions for form mutations instead of API routes
- Implement proper error boundaries with `error.tsx` at each route segment
- Prefer `Suspense` boundaries with fallbacks over manual loading state management
